results.content:
The latest generic congressional ballot polling continues to show Democrats with an edge nationally. RealClearPolling’s generic congressional vote tracker showed Democrats ahead of Republicans in the overall polling average by a 7-point margin.

results.content:
This Economist/YouGov poll was conducted July 31 to Aug. 3 among 1,609 adults. The poll's margin of error was plus or minus 3.6 percentage points.

## Democrats’ performance

With Trump's continued unpopularity amongst the American public, Democrats have gained some ground politically, as they lead Republicans by 8 percentage points on a generic congressional ballot. In last week's Economist/YouGov poll, Democrats held a 4-point lead.
